body: SEMANTIC ZOOM IMPLEMENTED, FINAL ARTIFACT COURT UNDERWAY: both existing axes are live and independent (Story/Episode/Scene x Hidden/Sentences/Tokens), each committed state is an exact ZoomLevel in receipts, focus/selection/horizon and compiled placements survive transitions, and stale completions are rejected by revision. Exact source-pinned cross-platform gate passed 108 tests plus link. Three mutations were killed: zero hysteresis, publish-all completions, and hard-coded Hidden. Type review also replaced forgeable state and unsupported-level sentinel fallback with unforgeable classes and a typed error. I am rebuilding the static edition and running Chromium smoke before the narrow commit.
